item.title: Jess & Jill — Fri Aug 7, 8:00 PM — Shiloh & Gaines
item.description:
THIS FRIDAY! August 7th 🌟 Jess & Jill are the award-winning Americana duo of Jesse Wagner and Jillian Todd, three-time Key West Duo of the Year winners. Blending influences from Jerry Garcia, Joni Mitchell, Gillian Welch, and David Rawlings, their heartfelt sound weaves together folk, bluegrass, Celtic, funk, and jam-band roots. Now based in Asheville, they’re recording their debut album of original music at Echo Mountain Recording and captivating audiences with rich harmonies, honest songwriting, and undeniable chemistry 🧪 💚🍃🦎🦠 9-12 Shiloh & Gaines – Your neighborhood bar……no matter where you live. Coffee ~ Spirits ~ Pool ~ Darts ~ Live Music ~ Dog Friendly ~ Karaoke & More! Find our music schedule and more at shilohandgaines.com
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Justin Ray Quartet — Fri Aug 7, 8:00 PM — Hotel Eve Jazz
item.description: Trumpeter & Vocalist Justin Ray brings his quartet to the stage alongside Tim Fischer on guitar, Steve LaSpina on bass and Alan Hall on Drums for an evening of world-class jazz. A Berklee College of Music graduate, Justin has performed with artists including Michael Bublé, Kurt Elling, Dave Weckl, Kamasi Washington, and more. During his nearly 20 years with Michael Bublé’s band, he toured internationally, appeared on Grammy-winning recordings, and performed at iconic venues including Madison Square Garden, the Hollywood Bowl, Radio City Music Hall, and the Sydney Opera House. Now based in Asheville, Justin is also an acclaimed composer, arranger, and educator whose performances blend virtuosic musicianship with deep jazz tradition. $10 weekdays -$15 weekends at the door (all ticket proceeds are 100% passed to the band, backed by a living wage guarantee from Hotel Eve) *Reserve a table in advance, or join us impromptu the night of the show. Graveyard Fields/Black Balsam Loop 9.5 miles — Tue Aug 11, 8:45 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group Graveyard Fields/Black Balsam loop Length: 9.5 miles Elevation: 1,500’ Speed: 2.5mph average Difficulty: Moderate to difficult
Hike starts at Graveyard Fields parking at 9:30.
The hike will start at Graveyard Fields heading towards the lower falls. We’ll pick up the Mountain to Sea trail and follow to the Art Loeb Trail. We’ll take the Art Loeb up to Black Balsam (probably have lunch there), Tennent Mountain and over to Ivestor Gap. From Ivestor Gap we’ll take the Graveyard Ridge trail back.
If anyone wants they can stop at the lower falls before heading to the car and cool off.
Dogs are welcome. I’ll have my dog with me.
For a car pool meet at the Pisgah Ranger station at 8:45AM for a 9:00 sharp departure. Or meet at the Graveyard Fields parking lot for a 9:30 departure.
Source: Asheville Hiking Group

Bluegrass and Ice Cream — Sun Aug 16, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Hendo Fun Friends Gathering on the third Sunday evening each month in the Hendersonville Presbyterian Church (HPC) community room, a crowd of up to 200 people enjoy a special blend of bluegrass and gospel music interspersed with humorous anecdotes and inspirational messages — and free ice cream and cookies to boot!
Usually fewer than 20 percent of those attending are members of HPC. The rest of the audience comes from various backgrounds, denominations and ages to hear the combination of original gospel music and old-time Southern gospel songs. A love offering for the band is taken, but giving is strictly voluntary. HPC is located at the corner of Seventh Avenue and Grove Street. Parking is in the rear of the church and accessible from Grove and King Streets and from Sixth Avenue. For more information about the church and the Bash, visit hendersonvillepc.org or call the church office, 828-692-3211.
Source: Hendo Fun Friends
